user.title: Add a Govee H60A4
user.description: Turn on LAN Control for the light in the Govee Home app first. Give the light a fixed IP address in your router.

data_description.host: The light's address on your network. The integration sends commands to UDP port 4003. There is no connection test, because the light's replies go to a port the Govee Lights Local integration already uses.
data_description.name: Device name, for example Living Room.
data_description.main_entity: The existing light entity for this lamp, usually from the Govee Lights Local integration. It shows up next to the Ring on the same device.

data_description.host: The new address of the light.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname.

abort.already_configured: This light is already set up.

data_description.main_entity: Leave empty to remove the Main light from this device.

set_segments.name: Set ring segments
set_segments.description: Colour individual ring zones (0-18). Neighbouring zones blend into each other.

segments.name: Segments
segments.description: Zone numbers 0-18. Leave empty for the whole ring.

rgb_color.name: Colour
rgb_color.description: One colour for all listed zones.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness of the listed zones. 0 turns them off.

gradient.name: Gradient
gradient.description: A list of RGB colours spread across the listed zones.

send_failed.message: Could not send to the light at {host}: {error}

invalid_segments.message: Segments {segments} don't exist. Use zones 0 to {max}.

not_ring.message: Set ring segments only works on a Ring light.
